messages:
Alex Ruiz: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we're tracking a recurring "stuttering" pattern on the streaming/chat endpoint: clients see partial chunks, then ~2–6s silence, then stream resumes. Root hypothesis: client handshake + backoff interplay with our rate-limiter and KV-cache warmup. Putting owners/timelines below, please ack and update your tasks. cc @Maria Ng @Kevin Choi

Maria Ng: Ack. I'll own the observability side — create a per-session inter-chunk delta histogram, plus alert for >3s median gap over 5m. Will add a dashboard with session-level trace links. ETA: EOD Thu.

Kevin Choi: I can investigate server-side handshake timeout behavior and reconnect handling in the runtime. Hypothesis: we treat some reconnects as new sessions causing KV-cache misses which exacerbate latency. I'll run a test with longer handshake window and baked-in KV reseed suppression. ETA: Fri AM.

Sarah Li: I'll draft a short customer-facing note if this impacts beta customers and coordinate with support on any in-flight tickets. Will review once we have clear SLO/mitigation.

Alex Ruiz: Action items (rough):
- Observability / dashboards (Maria) — histogram + session traces + alert — EOD Thu
- Runtime reconnect flow analysis (Kevin) — check handshake timeout, KV-cache reseed behavior, and fallback routing — Fri AM
- Short-term mitigations (Alex) — add client-side recommended reconnect jitter and reduce rate-limiter aggressiveness for existing sessions — target rollout Wed next week
- Customer comms (Sarah) — standby until we have mitigations, draft ready by Fri
- Postmortem follow-up check-in (all) — next sync Mon 11:00 PT

Maria Ng: For the observability query I'll add a derived metric: inter_chunk_gap_ms per session and a 95th percentile alert > 3000ms over 10m. Also adding a view that ties gaps to node_id and model_variant so we can spot correlated hardware/quantization issues.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket #INC-9821 created and assigned to incidents channel.

Kevin Choi: Quick log snippet that shows one of the gaps — copying here for context:
```
[2026-03-20T14:22:10Z] session=abc123 chunk=5 ok
[2026-03-20T14:22:11Z] session=abc123 chunk=6 ok
[2026-03-20T14:22:14Z] session=abc123 chunk=7 ok  <-- 3s gap
[2026-03-20T14:22:18Z] session=abc123 chunk=8 ok
```
Pattern looks like small clusters of 1–4s gaps intermittently.

Alex Ruiz: Kevin, can you add a short experiment: extend handshake timeout from 2s -> 6s for a canary fleet and compare inter_chunk_gap metric before/after? Also, instrument whether reconnection triggers a full KV cache cold start. If yes, that's likely the multiplier.

Kevin Choi: Will run canary tomorrow. I'll also add a trace flag to skip KV reseed for reconnects that happen within 10s. We'll measure tail latency impact.

Maria Ng: FYI I'm adding a quick synthetic test: 1000 concurrent sessions emitting 1 token/s to surface backpressure effects. If we see gaps, trace to node_id and route. Running mid-day tomorrow.

Sarah Li: If we end up rolling out a client-side recommendation (jitter + exponential backoff with cap), can we make it a minor SDK patch? That helps customers reduce churn early.

Alex Ruiz: Yes — I'll prepare a small SDK note and publish a patch if Kevin's canary shows improvements.

Maria Ng: One more ask — add tags for "partial-response" and "timeout-gap" to all related alerts so we can correlate in the incident stream.

Alex Ruiz: Agreed. For accountability: Maria (obs), Kevin (runtime/experiment), Alex (short-term mitigation & SDK note), Sarah (customer comms). Please update the INC-9821 ticket with discrete checkboxes and ETA. Next sync Mon 11:00 PT; if any blocker arises ping #eng-runtime.

Kevin Choi: ACK. I'll post canary results and a small diff for the KV reseed skip logic in the thread.

Maria Ng: ACK. Dashboard link will be posted here when ready.

Sarah Li: ACK. I'll prepare a tentative comms draft and wait for results.

Alex Ruiz: Thanks everyone — dumping this into the ticket now. Ending notes: watch for correlated spikes on node_id and rolling restart windows; if we see patterns across regions, escalate to infra.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next incident follow-up meeting scheduled Mon 11:00 PT.
